description_expanded: 🌊 My Blue Sky | Gulf-View Home with Exclusive Beach Access on 30A My Blue Sky is a thoughtfully maintained Gulf-view home located in the highly sought-after Old Blue Mountain Beach neighborhood on 30A. With exclusive beach access, walkability to dining and amenities, and a quiet residential setting, this home is ideal for guests who value location, comfort, and a relaxed coastal experience. The exclusive beach access — available only to Old Blue Mountain Beach residents and guests — is located just one minute from the front door at the end of a quiet street, offering a rare and highly desirable beach experience along 30A. 🏡 The Home Designed in classic Old Florida cottage style, My Blue Sky features four bedrooms and three and a half baths, comfortably accommodating up to eight guests. While the home is part of a twin structure with a separately owned neighboring unit, guests enjoy a quiet stay with no shared amenities and a peaceful residential feel. The home is arranged across three levels: Ground Floor Includes a convenient walk-in bonus shower, perfect for rinsing off after a day at the beach. Second Floor The main living space features an open-concept living area, a fully stocked kitchen with granite countertops, and a screened-in porch — ideal for morning coffee or unwinding in the evening. Third Floor All bedrooms are located on this level: Two Gulf-side queen bedrooms with private en-suite baths A shared Gulf-view deck One queen bedroom One bunk bedroom featuring a twin over full bed A shared Jack-and-Jill bathroom Full-size washer and dryer for guest convenience 🌴 Outdoor Features & Amenities Exclusive beach access for Old Blue Mountain Beach residents and guests Gulf views from the upper level and shared deck Fire pit with seating for six, perfect for relaxing evenings Four bikes onsite for exploring 30A and the Timpoochee Trail Covered two-car carport providing shaded parking OK2Charge EV charger available for guest use (activation via email or QR code) 📍 Location Highlights My Blue Sky is ideally positioned for guests who enjoy walking and biking: Short walk to dining, coffee, and local shops Easy access to the 17-mile Timpoochee Trail Grayton Beach is just 1.5 miles east, offering iconic dining and shopping A Publix grocery store is located approximately two miles away on Highway 98 Guests can download the 30A app to stay up to date on local events, festivals, and live music during their stay. ⚠️ House Rules & Important Information No parties, events, bachelor, or bachelorette groups Guests under 25 must be accompanied by an adult chaperone for the duration of the stay No smoking No pets Violations of these policies may result in immediate eviction without refund. ⭐ Why Guests Choose My Blue Sky ✔ Exclusive beach access in Old Blue Mountain Beach ✔ Gulf views and walkable location ✔ Quiet residential setting ✔ Bikes included for exploring 30A ✔ Fire pit and outdoor gathering space ✔ EV charger onsite
